description.value:
Militech holds the frontline, but behind enemy lines NUS special forces tend to field less standard armaments. One of their common choices is Tsunami’s exceptional Kyubi precision rifle, though with oodles of field mods. In 2068, NUSSOCOM directly contracted Tsunami Arms to design a revised model with some steep requirements: Don’t reduce muzzle velocity, boost accuracy, increase capacity, and be fully automatic. As usual, Tsunami Arms didn’t fail to perform, and exceeded every checkmark. Thus, the Tamamo is one of the most effective — and expensive — rifles in the world. This is the sort of firepower a blank check can really buy.

Cost: 7,500eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 6d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Flared Magwell (w/ Extended Magazine), Magrail Kit (w/ Kanetsugu Short Scope & Silencer), Power Rebuild, Sling, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: When firing this weapon in Single Shot, the user may choose to expend 1 additional round (2 Total) to ignore any Critical Failure (1s) they roll during the Attack Check (thus not rolling an implosion 1d10). These rolls are still treated as 1, however. Requires BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms unless Mounted to be fired in Autofire without inflicting a -4 penalty to the user’s Autofire Check.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Flared Magwell (w/ Extended Magazine), Magrail Kit (w/ Kanetsugu Short Scope & Silencer), Power Rebuild, Sling, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 6d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
